/.title: Samuel Demir – Curriculum Vitae | Senior Data Engineer/Architect
/.description: Samuel Demir – Senior Data Engineer/Architect with expertise in Python, Databricks, Apache Spark, Azure, Terraform, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and lakehouse architecture. View his CV, experience, projects, skills, and education.
p: I am a Senior Data Engineer/Architect specializing in Databricks, PySpark, batch and streaming data pipelines, and Big Data solutions. I design and build scalable, reliable data platforms and cloud solutions using Azure, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Terraform, Python, Docker, and Databricks. I also develop data models and interactive dashboards with Power BI and DAX, transforming complex data into actionable insights.  Alongside my data engineering expertise, I am a Magento 2 Full-Stack Developer and the owner of the e-commerce shop thelittlegoldsmith.ch. I combine strong technical expertise with hands-on entrepreneurial experience in digital commerce, working with PHP, Magento 2, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related web technologies.

As a Senior Data Engineer/Architect, I design and develop scalable data platforms and cloud solutions using Apache Spark/PySpark, Databricks, Python, SQL, Docker, and Terraform. I combine cloud engineering, data engineering, data architecture, data analytics, and visualization engineering to deliver complete end-to-end data products. My expertise covers data extraction and integration, Change Data Capture (CDC), Oracle-based data pipelines, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, cloud networking, security and RBAC, infrastructure as code, and modern lakehouse architectures. From extracting data from source systems and building robust, scalable data pipelines to modeling, analyzing, and visualizing data with Power BI and DAX, I cover the entire data journey and build production-ready data products from source to final dashboard.

Founded and developed thelittlegoldsmith.ch, an online jewelry shop designed and built with a personal focus on both user experience and functionality. The shop is based on Magento 2, using PHP, Magento 2, Shell, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery for development, customization and maintenance.

As a Senior Data Engineer at Galliker, I built and further developed a modern data platform based on Azure Databricks, including Azure Data Factory, Power BI, Terraform, Python, PySpark, and Docker. I designed the Azure Databricks platform and Lakehouse architecture and implemented the underlying data use cases to deliver scalable and automated data solutions.

Founded and developed the online shop goldschmiede-jaqueline.de using Magento 2, with a focus on Linux/LAMP, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS. Responsible for the technical development, customization and ongoing optimization of the e-commerce platform.

Developed and implemented streaming and batch data-processing use cases using PySpark and Databricks, primarily for the automotive industry at Mercedes-Benz AG and Daimler Truck AG. Leveraged Python, Docker, and Databricks to build scalable and production-ready data solutions.

At J.M. Voith AG, I completed my Master’s thesis on anomaly detection in transient operating conditions of hydropower plants, focusing on complex operating sequences such as start-up, shutdown, and water-level changes. I developed data-driven approaches for detecting abnormal system behavior using Python, Pandas, Polars, and Scikit-learn, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and machine learning-based anomaly detection. This work combined data science, time-series analysis, and domain-specific engineering knowledge to identify deviations and anomalies in real-world industrial sensor data.

As a Frontend Developer at Zenubia Schmuck AG, I was responsible for the development and technical operation of the company’s e-commerce platform based on Magento 2. I built and maintained the underlying LAMP infrastructure (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP), coordinated product data flows from suppliers into the online shop, and developed standardized import processes for product information. I also contributed to frontend development, data quality management, and the integration of supplier data, ensuring reliable and up-to-date product information throughout the platform.

As a Battery Container Engineer for the Formula Student team at DHBW Stuttgart, I designed and developed the vehicle’s battery container using CATIA. I conducted composite material testing with carbon fibre, glass fibre, and Kevlar, including shear and bending tests, to evaluate and optimize the structural performance of the container. Through iterative design and material optimization, I reduced the container’s weight by 3 kg compared with the previous year’s design while maintaining the required structural performance. The team achieved 1st place in the Acceleration discipline at Formula Student Germany in Hockenheim and finished 3rd overall.

As a dual student at DHBW Stuttgart, I studied Mechanical Engineering with Computer Science as an integral part of the curriculum while working at ERNI Production GmbH & Co. KG. Alongside my academic studies, I gained practical experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing processes, simulation, and technical development. My bachelor thesis focused on optimizing the injection molding process of a connector housing through simulation-based investigations and pressure and temperature monitoring, combining mechanical engineering knowledge with analytical and data-driven methods.
Master of Science - Data Management & Computer Science

Completed a comprehensive program focused on data science and intelligent systems, combining machine learning, deep learning, Python, SQL, and advanced data analytics to develop data-driven solutions for complex real-world problems.
Bachelor of Engineering - Mechanical Engineering & Computer Science

Completed a comprehensive program combining mechanical engineering and computer science, with a strong foundation in mathematics, physics, thermodynamics, mechanics, strength of materials, control engineering, and programming, applying engineering principles to complex technical systems and real-world problems.

Completed a technical-focused secondary education with an emphasis on computer science, programming, Java, Python, computer hardware, mathematics, physics, and engineering, building a strong foundation in software development and technical systems.
